description: REAL-TIME current weather for any location worldwide. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what's the weather in X", "current temperature in Y", "is it raining in Z". Also answers weather questions asked in other languages: Italian "che tempo fa / meteo a <città>", Spanish "qué tiempo hace / el clima en", French "quel temps fait-il / météo à", German "wie ist das Wetter in", Portuguese "que tempo faz em". Accepts a city name (e.g., "Tokyo", "London", "Napoli", "Austin TX") or lat/lon coordinates. Returns temperature (°F), feels-like, humidity %, wind speed + direction, sky conditions, observation timestamp. Live data.

latitude.description: Latitude (alternative to location). Accepts lat as alias.

location.description: City name (e.g. "Tokyo", "London", "New York"). Resolved via Open-Meteo geocoding. Use this OR latitude+longitude. Accepts city, place, name as aliases.

longitude.description: Longitude (alternative to location). Accepts lng / lon as alias.

name: get_weather

conditions.description: Weather condition description from WMO code

wind_mph.description: Wind speed in miles per hour

title: Get Weather
